newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy sets ESELCO acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy sets ESELCO acquisition.

text.p: ESELCO Inc said it agreed to be acquired by Wisconsin Energy Corp in an exchange of stock valued at about $71 million.
ESELCO said each share of its stock would be converted into Wisconsin Energy stock valued at $44.50 in a transaction structured to be a tax-free reorganization.

Wisconsin Energy said the number of shares it issues will be determined by the price of its stock during the period specified in the agreement. The company also said ESELCO will pay a fee of $2 million if it terminates the agreement to pursue a merger with a party unrelated to Wisconsin Energy.
The comnpanies said the transaction is contingent on several conditions, including the approval of ESELCO shareholders and regulators.
They said holders of ESELCO, the parent corporation of Edison Sault Electric Co, are expected to vote later this year. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
